description.short_caption: Modified acid-fast stain showing filamentous branching organisms.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a modified acid-fast stain of a specimen, revealing thin, filamentous, branching organisms stained bright pink against a blue background. The branching morphology is characteristic of certain actinomycetes, such as Nocardia species. The contrast between the pink-stained organisms and the blue background highlights the acid-fast nature of the organisms.

description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion on the upper arm.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the lateral aspect of an upper arm with a single, round, erythematous lesion. The lesion appears slightly raised and is surrounded by normal skin.
